basic_profile.bio: Avid fan of webtoons and fantasy novels, especially 'The Second Coming of Gluttony'. Based in Austin, Texas, I'm a night owl who spends my late hours diving into the world of animated storytelling. By day, I'm a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my hobbies. I enjoy exploring niche internet communities, and I'm currently single. I have a particular dislike for rushed adaptations of novels into other media forms.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having spent countless hours immersed in webtoons and light novels, I have developed a rich understanding of narrative structures and character development. My expertise is largely self-taught, stemming from a passion for storytelling and the online communities that discuss them.
